name: Epsilon Harmony
description: A client module to connect to Epsilon Harmony APIs.
project_description: Developers-only client for the Epsilon Agility Harmony marketing/customer-data platform. It exposes a single Drupal service (epsilon_harmony.api_service) with pre-defined methods that call the Harmony REST APIs over OAuth2: create/update/delete/retrieve a profile record, create/update a list record, and send a real-time message (RTM). Connection credentials (client ID, secret key, username, password, X-OUID) and the API region are entered on admin config forms; list and message identifiers are mapped to Epsilon IDs on companion forms. Every API request/response is written to a custom epsilon_harmony_log content entity for debugging, viewable and clearable in the admin UI. Depends on core Views. Supports Drupal 8 through 11.
